module: Ubuntu 20.04 Kernel Crypto API Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates random strings whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: The Ubuntu 20.04 Kernel Crypto API module is a software module running as part of the operating system kernel that provides general purpose cryptographic services.
tested_configurations: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-1019P-WTR with Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6226 CPU with PAA
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-1019P-WTR with Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6226 CPU without PAA (single-user mode)
allowed_algorithms: NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength)
